items.name: Target Ovarian Cancer
items.desc: Funds research into earlier diagnosis and better treatments, and provides information and support to patients across the UK.

items.name: The Eve Appeal
items.desc: The only UK charity funding research into all five gynecological cancers, with a focus on early detection and raising awareness.

items.name: Ovarian Cancer Research Alliance (OCRA)
items.desc: The largest funder of ovarian cancer research in the US, supporting scientists working toward better treatments and a cure.

items.name: Ovarian Cancer Action
items.desc: Campaigns for better outcomes through research funding, policy work, and connecting patients with the resources they need.

items.name: National Ovarian Cancer Coalition (NOCC)
items.desc: Runs awareness and support programs across the US while advocating for earlier diagnosis and better outcomes.

items.name: Ovacome
items.desc: Provides specialist ovarian cancer information and a support network for patients, carers, and healthcare professionals.

items.name: Ovarian Cancer Canada
items.desc: Funds ovarian cancer research in Canada and provides education, advocacy, and support services for people affected.

items.name: Ovarian Cancer Australia
items.desc: Provides support resources and education while driving public awareness and advocacy for ovarian cancer in Australia.

items.name: Ovarian Cancer Research Foundation (OCRF)
items.desc: Dedicated to funding ovarian cancer research with a focus on prevention, detection, and better treatment pathways.

items.name: World Ovarian Cancer Coalition
items.desc: A global coalition working to improve survival and quality of life through policy, data, and international collaboration.

items.name: Emer Casey Foundation
items.desc: Supports ovarian cancer research, patient support, and national awareness efforts to improve diagnosis and treatment outcomes in Ireland.

givingNote: All charities listed here are linked to their official websites. Before donating, review each organization's latest impact reports and financial statements to match your giving goals.
